newsitem.title: USA: Mobil says La. fire cuts 43 mmcfd natgas.
newsitem.headline: Mobil says La. fire cuts 43 mmcfd natgas.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Wednesday a small fire Tuesday on a platform offshore Louisiana has cut about 43 million cubic feet per day of natural gas production.
"There was a fire aboard the Green Canyon 18 platform yesterday at about noon central time (1200 CST). The fire was extinguished immediately," a company spokesman said.
The plaform, located about 110 miles south of Morgan City, La., is in about 760 feet of water, he said, noting 63 employees were on board at the time of the fire.
The company is currently investigating the cause of the fire and would not speculate on when production could resume.
About 21,000 barrels per day of crude and condensate was also affected by the fire, he said.

Traders said initial rumors of the fire contributed to an early rally in Henry Hub natural gas futures on NYMEX, causing the January contract to soar to a high of $3.52, up 12.4 cents. At 1124 EST, January was up only 0.4 cent at $3.40.
